reason: The free first visit costs me nothing and I would rather sit with a real coffee than chase my kid around somewhere loud, so I would go once and likely pay for one more visit on a weekend. I would not buy a pack or membership until I see it is actually cleaner and calmer than CoCo's.
objection: Isn't this just CoCo's Funhouse with nicer decor? With daycare costs up, $15 a visit adds up fast and I am not paying a premium for pretty unless it is really calmer and cleaner.
would_change_my_mind: A lower per-visit price or a drop-in price that includes siblings cheaply, plus proof on my first visit that it is truly uncrowded and clean.
